# `ConstantArbitrary`

`Rasuvaeff\PropertyTesting\Arbitrary\ConstantArbitrary`

**Class** — **Package:** [property-testing-core](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/property-testing-core) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/property-testing-core/blob/master/src/Arbitrary/ConstantArbitrary.php#L22) — **Version:** working tree

**Implements:** [`ArbitraryInterface`](/api/classes/ArbitraryInterface)

**Type parameters:**

- `TValue of mixed = mixed`

Always produces the same fixed value. Useful as a building block for composite
generators (e.g. a `record` field that is held constant) and for pinning one
parameter while others vary.

There is nothing smaller than a constant, so it does not shrink.
